fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-05-09 (night, 01:55): A message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 18,500 was transferred out. Contact details given by the complainant, Harish Pandian, include the number 9000000199. The complainant could not identify the person but reported communication from the number 9000000198. Ganesh Shankar (9000000155), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100021. A witness, Pavithra Bai, reachable on 9000000006, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, receiving account, night, screenshot, associate, main street, witness
